entries.note: This is a loopback-only desktop service. HTTP and WebSocket requests need the private runtime token and compatible Origin; it is not the Quest pairing protocol. Tokens stay in mode-0600 local state, never tracked files. Slow sockets reconnect to bounded retained output without stopping sessions. The retired browser bundle is no longer served; unknown non-API paths return 404. A later web client requires an explicit separate delivery decision. State advertises handoff capability version 1. A presented message must reference an ID previously attached on that authenticated socket; the native client sends it after drawing a waiting terminal. This is a local workflow protocol, not proof against an authenticated client deliberately forging readiness.
